summary_insights: The provided document is an Information Memorandum (IM) which contains an Income Statement but lacks a detailed Balance Sheet.
Page 26 of the document is explicitly titled 'Balance Sheet' but is marked with 'Information Required', indicating the data was not included in this version of the report.
While the Income Statement on page 25 shows profitability and EBITDA figures for 2022-2024, the corresponding asset and liability breakdowns are missing.
Property details on page 8 confirm the business operates from a leasehold premises with an annual rent of £35,400, but no book value for leasehold improvements is provided.
Without the Balance Sheet data, liquidity ratios (Current/Quick) and capital structure (Gearing) cannot be calculated or assessed.
The absence of a Balance Sheet prevents an analysis of the company's net asset growth or working capital management.
